name: elections
description: Collect, analyze, project, and estimate election results from official verified sources, backtest polls and Kalshi prediction markets against verified outcomes, and run a paper-trading forecasting contest (The Leap model) on open political/election markets.

scripts.pipeline: npm run backtest && npm run contest && npm run contest-forward && npm run crosslayer && npm run build-site && npm run market-list && npm run roadmap && node scripts/render-check.cjs
